Type: hexagon honeycomb wall shelf
Use: displaying plants, books and decor; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: glam, modern, art deco
Materials: gold-finished metal frame, glass shelves
Colors: gold, clear
Shape: three linked open hexagons in a honeycomb cluster, thin metal lines, geometric, light and open
Feel: glamorous, airy, graphic
Goes with: white or dark walls, velvet, marble, brass; glam or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Hexagon Honeycomb Floating Wall Shelf Unit with Glass Shelves - 28 x 28 x 6 Inch, Gold
product.description: This wall unit offers a modern take on shelving with 5 shelves cleverly integrated into an elegant honeycomb design. The glass shelves are held in place by 3 connected gold-colored iron hexagons. 28.35"H x 27.95"W x 5.91"D 95% iron; 5% glass Shelf unit Avoid moisture. This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware is included.
